meta.title: Security & Trust: governed data on Snowflake
meta.description: How Viewnear keeps enterprise data secure and governed: built on Snowflake's certified foundation, with governance, access control, and audit lineage in every engagement.

hero.title: Enterprise data, <hl>governed and secure</hl>.
hero.description: Viewnear builds in the client's Snowflake account, on Snowflake's independently audited platform (SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 across editions), and applies least-privilege access, PII classification, and Horizon Catalog lineage from the first table.

compliance.title: Built on a certified foundation
compliance.intro: We build on Snowflake's independently audited platform and extend it with our own governed delivery practices. The certifications below are Snowflake's, not Viewnear's. SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 apply across Snowflake editions; PHI and cardholder data need Business Critical or VPS, and PHI additionally needs a signed BAA with Snowflake before it is loaded.

platformCompliance.name: HIPAA
platformCompliance.note: Snowflake Business Critical or VPS, with a BAA in place

platformCompliance.name: GDPR-ready
platformCompliance.note: Regional deployment, access controls, and PII classification

practicesHeading.title: How we keep data safe
practicesHeading.intro: The controls we apply on every engagement by default, never as optional add-ons.

practices.label: Access
practices.title: Least-privilege access
practices.body: Role-based access control modeled to the organization, so people see only the data they need, enforced in Snowflake, not bolted on after.

practices.label: Lineage
practices.title: Lineage & auditability
practices.body: Horizon Catalog lineage and access history mean every figure is traceable to its source and every access is logged for audit.

practices.label: PII
practices.title: PII classification
practices.body: Sensitive data is classified, masked, and protected with tagging and row/column policies from the first table we build.

practices.label: Residency
practices.title: Data residency by region
practices.body: We deploy in the Snowflake region required across the Americas, so data stays where policy and regulators need it.

practices.label: Secrets
practices.title: Secrets & key management
practices.body: Credentials and keys are managed through the cloud's secrets and KMS services: never hard-coded, never shared in the clear.

practices.label: Delivery
practices.title: Secure delivery practices
practices.body: Code review, least-privilege delivery accounts, and environment separation are standard on every engagement.

governance.title: One governed foundation, <hl>not scattered copies</hl>
governance.body: Most data risk comes from sprawl: exports, shadow copies, and ungoverned spreadsheets. We consolidate onto a single governed Snowflake platform so access, lineage, and policy live in one place that can actually be audited.
bullets: A single governed source of truth, not data spread across tools
Access, masking, and retention policy enforced centrally
Full access history and lineage for audit and incident response
Open table formats (Apache Iceberg), queryable by any engine, no re-platforming

verticalsHeading.title: Compliance where it counts
verticalsHeading.intro: Regulated sectors carry specific obligations. We configure governance to the rules each industry answers to.

verticals.body: FINRA, SEC, and SOX-aligned reporting with auditable lineage and segregation of duties built in by design.
HIPAA-aligned handling of clinical and patient data, with masking, access policies, and audit trails designed in.
PCI-aware handling of payment and customer data, isolated and governed end to end.
